deviations.what: t5 slices each prediction at the shared padded prompt width (derived per row from attention_mask: pad_len + real_len), not at the row's own token count as the t5 instruction said; under left padding the instruction's literal reading would have kept pads + prompt in every short row and failed the acceptance criterion 'each prediction excludes its own prompt'. Also deleted _exporter._continuation/_eval_prompt/_score_predictions (named as owned symbols) because their logic moved into _trainer/metrics and nothing else referenced them.
deviations.reason: plan instruction contained a wrong offset rule; acceptance criteria are the contract and are met (3 load-bearing tests)

deviations.what: Live t9 run found that sloth export's --adapter/--output/--calib path sanitizer (_sanitize_path, export.py:246-273, landed in the #20 squash after its live validation) also runs INSIDE the container, where cwd is /workspace and HOME is the export home, so every real export exits 1 with 'path is outside the allowed roots' for the identity-mounted host path. Every export on main is broken. Proposed fix (not in any plan task): _container_kwargs forwards SLOTH_ALLOWED_ROOTS into the container env, set to the identity-mounted parents (adapter, output, calib, dataset), plus a unit test asserting the env reaches the docker argv and a fake in-container request under /workspace passes the sanitizer.
deviations.reason: blocking: t9's export rows (c10, c12, c21) cannot run until real exports work again

deviations.what: t9's docs/tested.md rows were committed on the same integration branch as the PR-A code (feat/follow-ups-22-a) instead of being held for PR B; PR A therefore ships with its own live evidence, and PR B carries t10 (benchmarks, Thor) + t11 (closeout) only.

deviations.what: qodo #2 on PR #25: t1's fail-closed CliError embedded the last 20 container lines in the message, which renders as ~22 lines and breaks the repo's two-line error:/hint: text contract (rubric). Fix: single-line message stating how many lines were captured and that they are on stderr (the tee already put them there); honesty condition h36's literal 'message contains the 40th line' is replaced by 'stderr contains the 40th line and the message is one line'.
deviations.reason: the rubric's two-line error contract outranks the literal h36 wording; the diagnostic content is preserved on stderr
